notes:
- Telemetry UI is redesigned with clearer chart rows and a dedicated raw payload pop-out.
- Telemetry now captures better install context (Revit build + runtime target) for diagnostics.
- Global telemetry stats are served from a dedicated endpoint backed by a refresh worker.
- Updater now supports standalone install/update without opening Revit.
- Release pipeline now publishes both updater executable and script with manifest checksums.
